description: Disk and RAM budget for the shipped app from Stage 4 onward. The cap and the tiered-model policy are owner decisions; the per-component allocations and RAM ceiling are proposals awaiting owner approval (Q-S4-12).

owner_decisions.decision: Base installed app (everything a user needs to run all entitled features) must not exceed 4 GiB; target 3 GiB. Keep RAM use low.

Tiered model policy: a 3B/4B-class local model is the default and ships in the base install; the 7B-class model becomes an optional add-on download for Pro/Judiciary users and is excluded from the base cap.
Remove regenerable clutter from the working folder (build logs, debug build cache).
owner_decisions.executed: 44 cargo/pid log files and eval/__pycache__ sent to Recycle Bin; src-tauri/target removed with `cargo clean` (1.9 GiB).

owner_decisions.decision: Continue the small-default search two ways: bake off phi4-mini and llama3.2:3b (1a) and a versioned small-model prompt requalified on existing gates plus new held-out cases (1b).
Base install ships Ollama core + CPU + Vulkan backends only; CUDA/ROCm libraries are an optional GPU accelerator add-on outside the base cap.
Repair the local Rust toolchain: reinstall Strawberry Perl and make msvc-env.ps1 discover the installed MSVC toolset.
owner_decisions.executed: Strawberry Perl 5.42.3.1 installed via winget (installer hash verified); msvc-env.ps1 now discovers the newest MSVC toolset containing cl.exe and the newest complete Windows SDK.

owner_decisions.decision: Use a more powerful local model than the 4B class: qwen2.5:7b (7.6B, Q4_K_M) is the DEFAULT model in the base install. Power is preferred over the 4 GiB cap for the model; the cap breach is recorded as waiver W-AC-S4-00.1, not hidden by raising the number. No separate add-on tier for now (a larger optional model can be added later through the same tier mechanism).

counts: installed official packs + indexes at first install

measured_baseline.verdict: OVER CAP - the 7B default model alone exceeds the remaining budget; resolved by OD-S4-MODEL-01 in B-S4-00.

runtime_packaging.finding_2026_10_08: B-S3-01 size script counted only ollama.exe (25 MB). The real Ollama install is 2.79 GiB: CUDA v12 1.11 GiB, CUDA v13 0.62 GiB, ROCm 0.94 GiB, Vulkan 0.04 GiB, CPU 0.04 GiB, core exe.
runtime_packaging.proposal: Base install ships the Ollama core + CPU + Vulkan backends (~0.11 GiB); Vulkan accelerates NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs generically. CUDA/ROCm libraries become an optional 'GPU accelerator' add-on outside the base cap.
runtime_packaging.verification: Installer build must prove the CPU+Vulkan-only runtime loads the default model and passes the fitness gate (B-S4-23).

ram.frozen_existing: AC-4.2 total RSS <= 7.2 GB on Full tier (unchanged until owner replaces it)
rules: One large model resident at a time (constants.model_choreography, unchanged).
Optional 7B add-on keeps the existing 7.2 GB ceiling and is never auto-loaded on machines under 8 GB RAM.
Stage 4 deterministic engines (rule tables, audit, deadlines, contradiction detection, issue matrix) must run with no model loaded.

selection_rules: Licence must permit offline commercial redistribution; verify from the official model card at bake-off time.
Must pass the existing B-S3-13 fitness gate (minimum_score 0.85, all required cases) with the CaseForge prompt, or the model is rejected.
Stage 3 grounding verifier remains the only trust path; a smaller model changes proposal quality, never trust rules.

excluded.reason: Reported as Qwen Research Licence (non-commercial); unusable for a paid product unless the licence is confirmed otherwise.
